chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ibn Mahbub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about a woman who sees in a dream that a man has intercourse with her in her private part until she emits fluid. He said: She performs ghusl (ritual bath).

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman about whom the legal ruling is asked
key_terms.الْمَنَامِ: sleep or dream state in which the experience occurs
key_terms.تَغْتَسِلُ: she performs ghusl, the required ritual bath
key_terms.تُنْزِلَ: to emit fluid, which is the basis of the ruling here
key_terms.فِي فَرْجِهَا: in her private part, describing the nature of the dream

ai.seo_question: Does a woman have to perform ghusl after experiencing discharge from a sexual dream?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that if a woman emits fluid due to a sexual dream, ghusl becomes obligatory upon her. It indicates that the ruling applies based on discharge occurring in sleep, establishing a matter of ritual purity.
